reading: Pure initiative. The situation is yours to start; nothing is waiting for permission.

yao.label: 九三
yao.text: 君子終日乾乾，夕惕若；厲，无咎。

image.en: Heaven doubled, and heaven never rests — force with nothing to soften it.

reading: Carry rather than lead. Strength here looks like patience and capacity.

yao.label: 六三
yao.text: 含章，可貞。或從王事，无成有終。

image.en: Earth upon earth — it carries everything and asserts nothing.

reading: The tangle at the start is normal, not a verdict. Do not push forward yet.

yao.label: 六二
yao.text: 屯如邅如，乘馬班如，匪寇婚媾，女子貞不字，十年乃字。

yao.label: 六三
yao.text: 即鹿无虞，惟入于林中，君子幾不如舍，往吝。

yao.label: 六四
yao.text: 乘馬班如，求婚媾，往，吉无不利。

image.en: Cloud and thunder, a storm that has not broken into rain — charge with no outlet yet.

judgment: 亨。匪我求童蒙，童蒙求我。
reading: You do not know enough yet, and that is fine. Ask; do not pretend.

yao.label: 初六
yao.text: 發蒙，利用刑人，用說桎梏，以往吝。

yao.label: 六三
yao.text: 勿用取女，見金夫，不有躬，无攸利。

image.en: A spring surfacing at the foot of a mountain — water with no channel, going nowhere until it is given one.

reading: Waiting is the action. The conditions are not ready, and forcing them costs more.

yao.label: 上六
yao.text: 入于穴，有不速之客三人來，敬之終吉。

image.en: Cloud massed high in the sky — the rain is coming, and nothing you do brings it sooner.

reading: A dispute you can win is still a dispute you pay for. Stop halfway.

yao.label: 九二
yao.text: 不克訟，歸而逋，其邑人三百戶无眚。

yao.label: 六三
yao.text: 食舊德，貞厲，終吉。或從王事，无成。

yao.label: 九四
yao.text: 不克訟，復即命渝，安貞吉。

yao.label: 上九
yao.text: 或錫之鞶帶，終朝三褫之。

image.en: Heaven turning one way and water running the other — each going where it must, and past the other.

reading: This needs organisation, not enthusiasm. Someone has to be accountable.

yao.label: 九二
yao.text: 在師中吉，无咎；王三錫命。

yao.label: 六五
yao.text: 田有禽，利執言，无咎。長子帥師，弟子輿尸，貞凶。

yao.label: 上六
yao.text: 大君有命，開國承家，小人勿用。

image.en: Water held underground — enormous force, useful only once it is organised.

reading: Alliance is available. Decide early whether you are in, rather than drifting in.

yao.label: 初六
yao.text: 有孚，比之，无咎。有孚盈缶，終來有它，吉。

yao.label: 九五
yao.text: 顯比。王用三驅，失前禽，邑人不誡，吉。

image.en: Water lying on open ground — it runs to the low places and gathers there; things join where they touch.

en: The Taming Power of the Small
reading: Clouds, no rain. Small accumulations only — the large move is not yet possible.

yao.label: 上九
yao.text: 既雨既處，尚德載，婦貞厲，月幾望，君子征凶。

image.en: Wind crossing the open sky — it moves things, but only a little, and not yet down here.

reading: You are closer to danger than you think, and conduct is what keeps you safe.

yao.label: 六三
yao.text: 眇能視，跛能履，履虎尾，咥人，凶。武人為于大君。

image.en: Heaven above, a lake below — a long way between them, and conduct is what keeps you upright on such ground.

reading: Things are moving in the right direction. Use the opening; it is not permanent.

yao.label: 九二
yao.text: 包荒。用馮河，不遐遺；朋亡。得尚于中行。

yao.label: 九三
yao.text: 无平不陂，无往不復，艱貞无咎。勿恤其孚，于食有福。

yao.label: 六四
yao.text: 翩翩，不富以其鄰；不戒以孚。

yao.label: 上六
yao.text: 城復于隍，勿用師，自邑告命，貞吝。

image.en: Heaven below and earth above, each moving toward the other — things are meeting.

reading: Communication has stopped. Withdraw rather than argue with a closed door.

yao.label: 九五
yao.text: 休否，大人吉。其亡其亡，繫于苞桑。

image.en: Heaven rising, earth sinking — each going its own way; nothing is meeting.

reading: Find the people who share the aim. Do it in the open, not in a private clique.

yao.label: 九三
yao.text: 伏戎于莽，升其高陵，三歲不興。

yao.label: 九五
yao.text: 同人，先號啕而后笑。大師克相遇。

image.en: Fire under an open sky — flame climbs toward it; like finds like.

reading: You have more than you are using. The problem is distribution, not scarcity.

yao.label: 九三
yao.text: 公用亨于天子，小人弗克。

image.en: Fire high in the sky — it lights everything at once, and everything is visible.

reading: Claim less than you could. It is the one position nobody attacks.

yao.label: 六五
yao.text: 不富，以其鄰，利用侵伐，无不利。

image.en: A mountain buried inside the earth — great height keeping itself level with the ground.

reading: Energy is gathering and wants a direction. Give it one before it scatters.

yao.label: 九四
yao.text: 由豫，大有得。勿疑。朋盍簪。

image.en: Thunder breaking out of the ground — stored energy released all at once.

reading: Adapt to what is actually happening. Leading here means going second, well.

yao.label: 初九
yao.text: 官有渝，貞吉。出門交有功。

yao.label: 六三
yao.text: 系丈夫，失小子。隨，有求得利，居貞。

yao.label: 九四
yao.text: 隨有獲，貞凶。有孚在道，以明，何咎。

yao.label: 上六
yao.text: 拘系之，乃從維之。王用亨于西山。

image.en: Thunder lying down inside a lake — the strong thing taking the shape of what holds it.

en: Work on What Has Been Spoiled
reading: Something was neglected and has gone bad quietly. Repair beats blame.

yao.label: 初六
yao.text: 幹父之蠱，有子考，无咎，厲終吉。

yao.label: 九三
yao.text: 幹父之蠱，小有悔，无大咎。

image.en: Wind caught beneath a mountain — air that cannot move goes stale.

judgment: 元亨利貞。至于八月有凶。
reading: An opening is approaching. Its window is shorter than it feels.

yao.label: 六三
yao.text: 甘臨，无攸利。既憂之，无咎。

image.en: Ground standing directly over water — close enough to look into; something is drawing near.

reading: Watch before you act. You are also being watched more than you realise.

image.en: Wind travelling across open country — it touches everything and settles nowhere.

reading: There is an obstruction that will not dissolve on its own. Name it directly.

yao.label: 九四
yao.text: 噬乾胏，得金矢，利艱貞，吉。

yao.label: 六五
yao.text: 噬乾肉，得黃金，貞厲，无咎。

image.en: Thunder and lightning together — the shock that cuts through whatever was in the way.

reading: Form matters here, but only as form. Do not mistake presentation for substance.

yao.label: 六四
yao.text: 賁如皤如，白馬翰如，匪寇婚媾。

yao.label: 六五
yao.text: 賁於丘園，束帛戔戔，吝，終吉。

image.en: Fire at the foot of a mountain — light that shows the shape of things without changing them.

reading: Something is coming apart and should be allowed to. Protect the core, drop the rest.

yao.label: 上九
yao.text: 碩果不食，君子得輿，小人剝廬。

image.en: A mountain wearing down onto the plain — the top is going, grain by grain.

reading: The turning point has already happened, quietly. Begin again small.

yao.label: 上六
yao.text: 迷復，凶，有災眚。用行師，終有大敗，以其國君，凶；至于十年，不克征。

image.en: Thunder still underground — the turn has already happened, and nothing shows yet.

reading: Act from the straightforward motive. Calculation will backfire here.

yao.label: 六二
yao.text: 不耕穫，不菑畬，則利有攸往。

yao.label: 六三
yao.text: 无妄之災，或系之牛，行人之得，邑人之災。

image.en: Thunder rolling under an open sky — everything acting straight out of its nature, nothing calculated.

en: The Taming Power of the Great
reading: Hold the force back so it accumulates. Restraint is building something.

yao.label: 九三
yao.text: 良馬逐，利艱貞。曰閑輿衛，利有攸往。

image.en: Heaven held inside a mountain — vast force deliberately contained, and accumulating while it waits.

reading: Watch what you are feeding yourself — attention, company, information.

yao.label: 六三
yao.text: 拂頤，貞凶，十年勿用，无攸利。

yao.label: 六四
yao.text: 顛頤吉，虎視眈眈，其欲逐逐，无咎。

yao.label: 六五
yao.text: 拂經，居貞吉，不可涉大川。

image.en: Thunder under a still mountain — the shape above, the movement below; a mouth, and what goes into it.

reading: The load exceeds the structure. Something must be set down before it breaks.

yao.label: 九二
yao.text: 枯楊生稊，老夫得其女妻，无不利。

yao.label: 九五
yao.text: 枯楊生華，老婦得其士夫，无咎无譽。

image.en: A lake risen over the treetops — the load has passed what the structure can carry.

reading: Danger repeating. You get through by being consistent, not clever.

yao.label: 六三
yao.text: 來之坎坎，險且枕，入于坎窞，勿用。

yao.label: 六四
yao.text: 樽酒簋貳，用缶，納約自牖，終无咎。

yao.label: 上六
yao.text: 係用徽纆，寘于叢棘，三歲不得，凶。

image.en: Water arriving and arriving, one pit and then the next — danger that repeats.

reading: Light depends on what it burns. Clarity here is borrowed, so tend the source.

yao.label: 九三
yao.text: 日昃之離，不鼓缶而歌，則大耋之嗟，凶。

yao.label: 九四
yao.text: 突如其來如，焚如，死如，棄如。

yao.label: 上九
yao.text: 王用出征，有嘉折首，獲匪其醜，无咎。

image.en: Light doubled — brilliant, and burning only as long as it has something to hold on to.

reading: Mutual attraction, still unspoken. Respond rather than strategise.

yao.label: 九四
yao.text: 貞吉悔亡，憧憧往來，朋從爾思。

image.en: A lake held in a mountain top — the solid thing hollowed to receive; felt before it is spoken.

reading: Endurance, not intensity. The question is what you can keep doing.

yao.label: 九三
yao.text: 不恆其德，或承之羞，貞吝。

yao.label: 六五
yao.text: 恆其德，貞，婦人吉，夫子凶。

image.en: Thunder and wind, which never arrive apart — a pairing that lasts because each renews the other.

reading: Withdrawing now is strategy, not defeat. Leave before you are forced to.

yao.label: 六二
yao.text: 執之用黃牛之革，莫之勝說。

image.en: A mountain under a withdrawing sky — heaven pulls upward, out of reach.

reading: You have real force available. Force without a reason becomes a mistake.

yao.label: 九三
yao.text: 小人用壯，君子用罔，貞厲。羝羊觸藩，羸其角。

yao.label: 九四
yao.text: 貞吉悔亡，藩決不羸，壯于大輿之輹。

yao.label: 上六
yao.text: 羝羊觸藩，不能退，不能遂，无攸利，艱則吉。

image.en: Thunder at the very top of the sky — as loud as force gets, and still only noise unless it is aimed.

reading: Advancement is visible and sanctioned. Move openly, at the pace offered.

yao.label: 初六
yao.text: 晉如，摧如，貞吉。罔孚，裕无咎。

yao.label: 六二
yao.text: 晉如，愁如，貞吉。受茲介福，于其王母。

yao.label: 六五
yao.text: 悔亡，失得勿恤，往吉无不利。

yao.label: 上九
yao.text: 晉其角，維用伐邑，厲吉无咎，貞吝。

image.en: The sun clearing the horizon — rising in the open, at the pace the day allows.

reading: The environment does not reward being seen clearly. Keep your own light lit inwardly.

yao.label: 初九
yao.text: 明夷于飛，垂其翼。君子于行，三日不食，有攸往，主人有言。

yao.label: 六二
yao.text: 明夷，夷于左股，用拯馬壯，吉。

yao.label: 九三
yao.text: 明夷于南狩，得其大首，不可疾貞。

yao.label: 六四
yao.text: 入于左腹，獲明夷之心，于出門庭。

yao.label: 上六
yao.text: 不明晦，初登于天，后入于地。

image.en: The sun gone down into the ground — the light still exists; it is just nowhere it can be seen.

reading: The small unit is what needs order. Fix the inside before addressing the outside.

yao.label: 九三
yao.text: 家人嗃嗃，悔厲吉；婦子嘻嘻，終吝。

image.en: Wind coming off a fire — the hearth inside, its draught spreading out; what is ordered within is what reaches beyond.

reading: You are pulling in different directions. Agree on small things; leave the large alone.

yao.label: 初九
yao.text: 悔亡，喪馬勿逐，自復；見惡人无咎。

yao.label: 六三
yao.text: 見輿曳，其牛掣，其人天且劓，无初有終。

yao.label: 九四
yao.text: 睽孤，遇元夫，交孚，厲无咎。

yao.label: 上九
yao.text: 睽孤， 見豕負涂，載鬼一車， 先張之弧，后說之弧，匪寇婚媾，往遇雨則吉。

image.en: Fire rising while water sinks — sharing one place and moving apart.

reading: The way ahead is blocked. Turning aside is not the same as giving up.

image.en: Water running down a mountainside — every way forward is steep and wet at once.

judgment: 利西南。无所往，其來復吉。
reading: The tension has broken. Do not immediately fill the space with new tension.

yao.label: 六五
yao.text: 君子維有解，吉；有孚于小人。

yao.label: 上六
yao.text: 公用射隼，于高墉之上，獲之，无不利。

image.en: Thunder and rain finally breaking — the pressure that had built is being let go.

reading: Give something up deliberately. Chosen loss is different from suffered loss.

yao.label: 六三
yao.text: 三人行，則損一人；一人行，則得其友。

yao.label: 六五
yao.text: 或益之，十朋之龜弗克違，元吉。

yao.label: 上九
yao.text: 弗損益之，无咎，貞吉，利有攸往，得臣无家。

image.en: A lake cut into the foot of a mountain — the hollow is what was taken away, and it is what holds the water.

reading: A window where effort compounds. Spend it outward, not on yourself.

yao.label: 六二
yao.text: 或益之，十朋之龜弗克違，永貞吉。王用享于帝，吉。

yao.label: 六三
yao.text: 益之用凶事，无咎。有孚中行，告公用圭。

yao.label: 六四
yao.text: 中行，告公從。利用為依遷國。

yao.label: 九五
yao.text: 有孚惠心，勿問元吉。有孚惠我德。

yao.label: 上九
yao.text: 莫益之，或擊之，立心勿恆，凶。

image.en: Wind and thunder amplifying each other — a window where effort returns more than it costs.

reading: The thing must be said out loud. Say it plainly and without contempt.

yao.label: 九三
yao.text: 壯于頄，有凶。君子夬夬，獨行遇雨，若濡有慍，无咎。

yao.label: 九四
yao.text: 臀无膚，其行次且。牽羊悔亡，聞言不信。

image.en: Water piled up as high as the sky — it cannot be held any longer; the thing has to break.

reading: Something small has entered that will not stay small. Notice it now.

yao.label: 初六
yao.text: 系于金柅，貞吉，有攸往，見凶，羸豕孚踟躅。

yao.label: 九三
yao.text: 臀无膚，其行次且，厲，无大咎。

yao.label: 九五
yao.text: 以杞包瓜，含章，有隕自天。

image.en: Wind under an open sky — it reaches everywhere, and it arrived without being invited.

reading: People are assembling. Gatherings need a centre or they become a crowd.

yao.label: 初六
yao.text: 有孚不終，乃亂乃萃，若號一握為笑，勿恤，往无咎。

yao.label: 六三
yao.text: 萃如，嗟如，无攸利，往无咎，小吝。

yao.label: 九五
yao.text: 萃有位，无咎。匪孚，元永貞，悔亡。

image.en: Water gathered on flat ground — things collect wherever there is somewhere to collect.

reading: Growth by accumulation, step by step. It will not feel dramatic.

image.en: A tree pushing up through soil — growth you never catch happening, only having happened.

reading: Constrained on all sides. Words carry no weight now; only conduct does.

yao.label: 初六
yao.text: 臀困于株木，入于幽谷，三歲不覿。

yao.label: 九二
yao.text: 困于酒食，朱紱方來，利用亨祀，征凶，无咎。

yao.label: 六三
yao.text: 困于石，據于蒺藜，入于其宮，不見其妻，凶。

yao.label: 九四
yao.text: 來徐徐，困于金車，吝，有終。

yao.label: 九五
yao.text: 劓刖，困于赤紱，乃徐有說，利用祭祀。

yao.label: 上六
yao.text: 困于葛藟，于臲卼，曰動悔。有悔，征吉。

image.en: A lake bed with the water gone — the whole shape of provision, and nothing in it.

reading: The source is still there and still works. What needs repair is the access.

yao.label: 九三
yao.text: 井渫不食，為我心惻，可用汲，王明，并受其福。

image.en: Water drawn up through wood — the well itself never moves; only the drawing does.

reading: The old arrangement has lost its reason to exist. Change it on a stated day.

yao.label: 九三
yao.text: 征凶，貞厲，革言三就，有孚。

yao.label: 上六
yao.text: 君子豹變，小人革面，征凶，居貞吉。

image.en: Fire burning inside water — two things that cannot both remain; one of them gives.

reading: Raw material, transformed by a process. Build the vessel, not just the ambition.

yao.label: 初六
yao.text: 鼎顛趾，利出否，得妾以其子，无咎。

yao.label: 九二
yao.text: 鼎有實，我仇有疾，不我能即，吉。

yao.label: 九三
yao.text: 鼎耳革，其行塞，雉膏不食，方雨虧悔，終吉。

yao.label: 九四
yao.text: 鼎折足，覆公餗，其形渥，凶。

image.en: Fire under wood, under a vessel — raw material becoming something else by being held and cooked.

reading: Shock arrives. The fright passes; what you do in the first minute matters.

yao.label: 初九
yao.text: 震來虩虩，后笑言啞啞，吉。

yao.label: 六二
yao.text: 震來厲，億喪貝，躋于九陵，勿逐，七日得。

yao.label: 上六
yao.text: 震索索，視矍矍，征凶。震不于其躬，于其鄰，无咎。婚媾有言。

image.en: Thunder, and then thunder again — the shock, and the second shock that tells you what you are made of.

reading: Stop. Not paused, not waiting for a signal — actually stop and be still.

yao.label: 六二
yao.text: 艮其腓，不拯其隨，其心不快。

image.en: Mountain against mountain — stillness that is not waiting for anything.

reading: Gradual, in the correct order. Skipping a stage undoes the ones before it.

yao.label: 初六
yao.text: 鴻漸于干，小子厲，有言，无咎。

yao.label: 九三
yao.text: 鴻漸于陸，夫征不復，婦孕不育，凶；利禦寇。

yao.label: 六四
yao.text: 鴻漸于木，或得其桷，无咎。

yao.label: 九五
yao.text: 鴻漸于陵，婦三歲不孕，終莫之勝，吉。

yao.label: 上九
yao.text: 鴻漸于陸，其羽可用為儀，吉。

image.en: A tree growing on a mountainside — years of it, and not one stage skipped.

reading: You are entering on someone else's terms. Know that before you agree.

yao.label: 六五
yao.text: 帝乙歸妹，其君之袂，不如其娣之袂良，月幾望，吉。

yao.label: 上六
yao.text: 女承筐无實，士刲羊无血，无攸利。

image.en: Thunder above a lake — the water moves because the thunder does; you are entering on terms set elsewhere.

reading: Peak. Enjoy it without pretending it is a plateau.

yao.label: 初九
yao.text: 遇其配主，雖旬无咎，往有尚。

yao.label: 六二
yao.text: 豐其蔀，日中見斗，往得疑疾，有孚發若，吉。

yao.label: 九三
yao.text: 豐其沛，日中見沫，折其右肱，无咎。

yao.label: 九四
yao.text: 豐其蔀，日中見斗，遇其夷主，吉。

yao.label: 上六
yao.text: 豐其屋，蔀其家，窺其戶，闃其无人，三歲不觌，凶。

image.en: Thunder and lightning arriving together — the fullest the sky gets, and the sun is already past noon.

reading: You are a guest here, not a resident. Travel light and behave well.

yao.label: 六二
yao.text: 旅即次，懷其資，得童僕貞。

yao.label: 九三
yao.text: 旅焚其次，喪其童僕，貞厲。

yao.label: 九四
yao.text: 旅于處，得其資斧，我心不快。

yao.label: 上九
yao.text: 鳥焚其巢，旅人先笑后號咷。喪牛于易，凶。

image.en: A fire on a mountainside — it burns where it lands and then moves on; nothing here belongs to it.

reading: Persistent, low-pressure influence. Repetition works where argument does not.

yao.label: 九二
yao.text: 巽在牀下，用史巫紛若，吉无咎。

yao.label: 九五
yao.text: 貞吉悔亡，无不利。无初有終，先庚三日，后庚三日，吉。

yao.label: 上九
yao.text: 巽在牀下，喪其資斧，貞凶。

image.en: Wind after wind — no single gust does anything; the repetition does.

reading: Open exchange, genuinely enjoyed. Keep it honest or it curdles into flattery.

image.en: Two lakes touching, each feeding the other — exchange that keeps both of them full.

reading: Rigidity is dissolving. Let the hard thing break up before rebuilding.

yao.label: 六四
yao.text: 渙其群，元吉。渙有丘，匪夷所思。

yao.label: 九五
yao.text: 渙汗其大號，渙王居，无咎。

image.en: Wind across the surface of water — what had set solid breaks up and disperses.

reading: Set a limit and keep it. But a limit that hurts to hold is the wrong limit.

image.en: Water above a lake with a rim — a container is only useful because it stops somewhere.

reading: Sincerity reaches further than technique here, including to people unlike you.

yao.label: 九二
yao.text: 鳴鶴在陰，其子和之，我有好爵，吾與爾靡之。

yao.label: 六三
yao.text: 得敵，或鼓或罷，或泣或歌。

image.en: Wind moving over water — the surface answers something that never touches it.

judgment: 亨，利貞。可小事，不可大事。
reading: This is a season for small correct acts. The grand gesture will miss.

yao.label: 六二
yao.text: 過其祖，遇其妣；不及其君，遇其臣；无咎。

yao.label: 九四
yao.text: 无咎，弗過遇之。往厲必戒，勿用永貞。

yao.label: 六五
yao.text: 密云不雨，自我西郊，公弋取彼在穴。

yao.label: 上六
yao.text: 弗遇過之，飛鳥離之，凶，是謂災眚。

image.en: Thunder heard on a mountain top — loud, and small against what it is standing on.

reading: It is finished, and that is exactly when things start to slip. Maintain.

yao.label: 九三
yao.text: 高宗伐鬼方，三年克之，小人勿用。

yao.label: 九五
yao.text: 東鄰殺牛，不如西鄰之禴祭，實受其福。

image.en: Water set over fire — everything in its right place, which is exactly when it starts to boil over.

reading: Almost there, and the last stretch is where it is lost. Do not relax yet.

yao.label: 九四
yao.text: 貞吉，悔亡，震用伐鬼方，三年有賞于大國。

yao.label: 六五
yao.text: 貞吉，无悔，君子之光，有孚，吉。

yao.label: 上九
yao.text: 有孚于飲酒，无咎，濡其首，有孚失是。

image.en: Fire above water — the two have not met yet; the work is almost, and not, done.
